reviews.source_text: The system shall support a C-language application programming interface (API).
reviews.rationale: Actual pure-C compilation, direct external C ABI linkage and calls into a real configured GMAT engine; no GUI or Python binding substitution.

reviews.source_text: The C-API shall provide access to the following data for a configured session:
reviews.rationale: Both required configured-session data children (object count and all names) pass exact inventory assertions.

reviews.source_text: 1) Get number of objects in configuration
reviews.rationale: Complete thirteen-object configuration count, including built-in objects and both independently configured spacecraft, force and propagation models.

reviews.source_text: 2) Get names of all configured objects
reviews.rationale: Every configuration index is enumerated; exact expected names and uniqueness are asserted.

reviews.source_text: 1) Set dynamics model Cartesian state vector by model
reviews.rationale: Caller-owned Cartesian vectors assigned to both independent model IDs without reloading; both selector APIs preserve isolated states.

reviews.source_text: 3) Get dynamics state acceleration by model
reviews.rationale: Two independent model accelerations at propagated and caller-assigned 3-D states match velocity plus Newton acceleration to 1e-12.

reviews.source_text: 6) Get dynamics model state vector by model
reviews.rationale: Full model state vectors after propagation, after assignment and after model switching are asserted element by element.

reviews.source_text: 7) Get text description of the state vector by model
reviews.rationale: Exact native description for every Cartesian element of both models; STM case additionally checks every STM element.

reviews.source_text: 8) Get size of the state vector by model
reviews.rationale: Both configured model dimensions match the requested propagated representation (6 basic, 42 STM).
All six post-run Cartesian components of both spacecraft match separate analytic circular trajectories with different radii, planes and durations.

reviews.source_text: 4) Get dynamics state Jacobian (A-Matrix) by model
reviews.rationale: STM derivatives at identity match independently derived Newton Jacobian; nonidentity Phi verifies A times Phi at two distinct states.

reviews.source_text: 5) Get dynamics state variational equations (STM time rate of change) by model
reviews.rationale: All 36 STM time-rate elements for two nonidentity matrices match independent A times Phi; no diagonal-only or dimension-only credit.
All 36 post-run STM entries for each spacecraft match central finite differences of independent C math-only RK4 point-mass propagation.

reviews.source_text: The C-API shall contain a dynamics model interface that supports the following actions without reloading the configuration:
reviews.rationale: All eight dynamics-interface actions are asserted in the single two-model STM session, without reloading after configuration: Cartesian and A1 epoch setters, scalar/precise native model/force epoch inspection, acceleration, Jacobian, nonidentity STM rate, full state, description and size. Rejected epochs preserve the prior state and both model selections retain isolated epochs.

reviews.source_text: 2) Set dynamics model epoch by model in the following formats:
reviews.rationale: A1ModJulian is the sole listed format child. External C caller-assigned epochs reach native propagation scalar/precise state and force/model storage; setting either model leaves the other unchanged.

Distinct literal A1ModJulian epochs are set through SetState and GetDerivativesForState; a separate read-only test module observes five actual native scalar/precise state/model/force epoch values, with equality and rejection/isolation assertions.

held_scope: C-API high-level MATLAB interface and linked FRR/FRC configuration families are not inferred from these examples.
All-command summaries including nested mission commands remain unverified.
Deferred spacecraft epoch getter is not exported by the present C ABI.
Derivative-array lifetime and dimension-change safety remain separate unverified cases.
